name: dsh-llm-model-tuning
description: Per-model reasoning-effort levels, multimodal input settings, and Magpie gateway model import for custom (llm-pi-ai) providers in the DSH Models settings page, with automatic models.dev completion for sparse gateway listings and compatibility for gateways that decorate model ids (e.g. `cn:kimi-k3-1`) or spell detail fields differently (e.g. `attachments`, `reasoning_supported_efforts`). · 为自定义供应商的每个模型配置推理强度档位、多模态输入，并从 Magpie 网关导入模型能力；兼容 `cn:kimi-k3-1` 这类带标识的模型 id 与 `attachments`/`reasoning_supported_efforts` 等网关扩展字段，缺少模型详情时按 https://models.dev 智能匹配补全。

meta.title: Model Tuning — Reasoning, Multimodal, Magpie Import & models.dev Completion · 模型调优
meta.description: Adds a per-model reasoning-effort level editor, multimodal input settings, one-click Magpie gateway model import, and automatic models.dev completion for sparse model listings to every custom provider card in Settings → Models.
